description: Evaluation metadata for the India Startup Validator skill.
assertions: The skill produces a clear go/no-go/pivot verdict.
The analysis includes India-specific regulatory and distribution analysis.
Claims are labeled according to the honesty protocol (e.g., [Data], [Assumption]).
A 30-day validation plan with concrete experiments is provided.
INR pricing and local benchmarks are used for unit economics.
The pre-flight check covers incumbent, platform, regulatory, willingness-to-pay, distribution, unit economics, and prior-failure risks.
The verdict includes measurable kill or pivot criteria.
Funding and execution recommendations distinguish bootstrapping, grants, accelerators, angels, strategic partnerships, and institutional funding.
